name: small nuclear ribonucleoprotein D3 polypeptide

function.text: SNRPD3 is the approved symbol for small nuclear ribonucleoprotein D3 polypeptide. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in enzyme binding; histone pre-mRNA DCP binding; 7-methylguanosine cap hypermethylation.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cervical carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Endometrial carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
